The '''Aaron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1988]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], [[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'' video game]],<ref name="Auren">[[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'' video game]] {{ID|Auren}} {{C|box packaging description and game manual only}}</ref> box packaging description and manual mention "[[Ingo/Legends|Ingo's moon]] — [[Auren]]". A [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article, included a reference to the game's fanon title, ''Star Wars: Droids - Escape from Aaron''<ref name="SWI">{{InsiderCite|40|Atari Wars}} {{ID|Aaron}}</ref> that was circulating the internet at the time, while [[2009]]'s, ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'' later listed an "Aaron system" based on these fan misspellings of the [[moon]], Auren. The error was further compounded by the [[2013]] StarWars.com article ''[[The Droids Re-Animated]], Part 2'' mentioning a "''planet Aaron''".<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|text=The Droids Re-Animated, Part 2|int=The Droids Re-Animated|nolive=1}}</ref>
